question: The Rajgir Zoo is located in which of the following states?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Bihar**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Rajgir Zoo Safari, also known as the Rajgir Wildlife Safari, is located in **Rajgir, Nalanda district in the state of Bihar**.
 
• It was officially opened in **February 2022**.
